subject: Request: HackSprint cohort boost — mentor stipends & additional promo credits

Cc: HackSprint Organizers <organizers@hacksprint.org>

Subject: HackSprint '26 — cohort boost request: mentor stipends and promo credits

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for Redwood's continued support for HackSprint. We had an unexpected surge in eligible mentor applications and a large late-stage influx of student teams; the mentorship cohort has grown from the 30 we planned to ~48 active mentors.

Quick ask: would Redwood be able to provide a one-time cohort "boost" — specifically: an additional 50 promotional credits to distribute to participating teams, and an extra stipend top-up pool (we estimate ~$2.5k total) to fairly compensate the mentors who were added after the initial roster?

We attached the current roster and an event budget that outlines the incremental stipend numbers. Ideal timeline: promo credits issued by end of next week and stipends processed the week after the event (we're flexible on the exact procurement workflow).

I know this is short notice — appreciate anything you can do. If helpful, I'm happy to jump on a 15-min call to walk through the numbers.

Best,
Alex Rivera
Program Director
HackSprint Foundation

Attachments: cohort_roster.csv (list of mentors), event_budget.xlsx (line-item stipend estimates)

Thanks — reviewed numbers. Finance will approve under the community sponsorship budget with the following conditions:

- Promo credits: approve 50 credits. We'll apply a promotional grant entry (non-recoupable) once Marissa confirms the exact issuance window.
- Stipend: approve up to $2,500. We need a short vendor form from HackSprint (organization EIN or payment remit details) and an itemized payout list (names + amounts).
- Timeline: we'll process the promo issuance within 48 hours after we get the signed promo terms; stipend payout will be via AP after vendor form is complete — target payout 7–10 business days post-submission.

Action items for Jordan: 1) Send the attached promo_terms.pdf to organizers to sign (I created a lightweight DocuSign packet: https://docusign.com/packet/redsprint-hs-9342), 2) Collect vendor remit info and stipend breakdown, 3) Confirm final list for credits. Once all are in, Finance will execute.

Rishi
